criteria.text: Provides a browser-based application for designing user interfaces
criteria.rationale: Distinguishes web-first, accessible-in-browser design platforms from native-desktop or non-browser tools.

criteria.text: Enables real-time collaborative editing of design files
criteria.rationale: Separates true collaboration tools where multiple users co-edit simultaneously from single-user or asynchronous-sharing design apps.

criteria.text: Provides built-in prototyping features for creating interactive UI flows
criteria.rationale: Differentiates platforms that support end-to-end interface design and interaction testing from tools focused solely on static visuals.

criteria.text: Provides developer handoff features that export design specifications or assets for engineering
criteria.rationale: Identifies tools that bridge design and engineering workflows versus tools that only produce visual files without handoff capabilities.

criteria.text: Supports vector-based graphical editing primitives suitable for interface design
criteria.rationale: Distinguishes scalable, UI-focused vector editors from raster-only image editors that are less suited to interface layout and scaling.
